reviewMethod: Agent visual inspection of actual Cycles CPU GLB-reimport PNG contact sheets plus template images; not city/browser acceptance
findings: Six templates are readable at true metre scale next to the 1 m ruler and 1.75/1.81 m human references
Column height, capital underside datum, full 28 m triangular pediment and tall upper-window opening remain coherent
Stepped window reveal is visible in LOD0/1; exact open hole remains at LOD2
Marine ceramic layers surround the retained empty arch and copper fan stays recessed above the lower doorway area
Side/top images show shallow wall-attached depth, no unexpected world displacement or double axis conversion
LOD2 visibly coarsens fluting, capital and arch layers while retaining bounds and CPU-tested apertures
Sunny/overcast/dusk/night materials are legible under fixed offline conditions; no baked illumination and no city brightness/performance claim
Waterfront assembly deliberately lacks retained shell, entablature and triangle infill; the assembly plan explicitly keeps them
limitations: Low-sample CPU research images, not photoreal restoration
Full runtime transition/facade seam/transparent-glass/night-light behavior remains not_run
